messages:
sam: Heads-up — after merging the adaptive KV prefetcher + INT4 GEMM toggle I see a 20-40% tail-latency regression on long contexts. Bisected to a change in the build flag (-DENABLE_PREFETCH). Perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/1800001234 :facepalm:
lee: Which model/seq len and infra? can you paste a quick summary of numbers?
sam: model=redwood-14b-int4, seq=4096, node=g4dn. Before vs after (p50,p95,p99):
```
before, 120ms, 190ms, 180ms
after, 140ms, 230ms, 260ms
```
Also saw increased GPU memory reads in the short traces.
anya: Could the prefetcher be causing extra PCIe/memory churn for large KV caches? prefetch + CUTLASS micro-tiling might increase occupancy but hurt steady-state throughput.
jordan: I ran perf counters locally — sm_efficiency down ~12%, l2_bw up ~30%, more replay stalls. Looks like extra DRAM reads from aggressive prefetch.
lee: Can we temporarily flip the runtime flag for canary? TRITON_FORCE_CUTLASS=0 and PREFETCH=off in runtime config should revert to the older path. Sam, can you run a 1h canary? :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary image roll initiated for eng-runtime at 1800001300, target subset=canary-5hosts.
sam: Running repro: ./tools/repro_int4_prefetch.sh --model redwood-14b-int4 --seq 4096 --iters 500. Posting nvprof snippets when done.
anya: While you're collecting nvprof, also capture cupti kernel timeline and CUTLASS perf counters (tile sizes, gmms). If prefetch moves work to a different kernel variant we might be hitting a less-optimal tile. Try reducing microtile 128->64 as an experiment.
jordan: Filed issue #4578 with graphs, nvprof snippets, and the bisect notes. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
sam: Quick interim data from repro (first 200 iters): p99 down to 195ms after disabling prefetch on the canary. So far looks like prefetch was the culprit. Full run will confirm.
lee: If confirmed, propose: 1) gate -DENABLE_PREFETCH behind arch detection (only enable on A100/P4?); 2) add batching heuristic to avoid prefetch when KV miss-rate > X; 3) add a fast path for INT4 that forces different CUTLASS tile. I'll draft RFC.
anya: Agreed. Also add runtime switch to auto-disable prefetch when observed sm_efficiency drops or L2 bw spikes.
sam: Will attach full traces and PR link when ready. Thanks everyone.
jordan: +1 to RFC. leaving notes on #4578, will add perf dashboards and a short repro runbook. :memo:
